source_corrections_and_limits: Exercise payoffs and funded terminal profits are kept separate.
All roots are restricted to the nonnegative stock domain and their relevant strike intervals.
Weak no-arbitrage inequalities allow degenerate boundary states.
Calendar long-option value is a continuation price, not a terminal intrinsic payment or a price maximized at the strike.
European maturity monotonicity needs assumptions; known-dividend counterexample given.
Static common-expiry identities are not claims that intermediate American assignment is irrelevant.
